summary: Iteration 33 — SaaS self-signup + Stripe subscription + paywall frontend sweep (mobile viewport 390x844). ALL 8 requested flows PASS. (1) /login shows 'Nouveau ? Créer un compte — essai gratuit 14 jours' testID=go-register, redirects to /register (fond bleu nuit #020830, champs Nom/E-mail/Mot de passe with proper testIDs). (2) Signup with qa.signup.1788178233@example.com / MotDePasse123! succeeds → redirect to home (/) — dashboard is empty as expected (0% occupation, 0 €, 0 logements, 0 à venir). (3) /settings/subscription shows '🎁 Essai gratuit en cours — 13 jours restants (jusqu'au 14/09/2026)' (14 - fractional first day ~ 13 correct) and the 4 plans: Starter 39€/mois (jusqu'à 3), Essentiel 79€/mois (jusqu'à 10) with brand border highlight and ⭐, Pro 149€/mois (jusqu'à 25), Scale 249€/mois (jusqu'à 50), each with 'Choisir' testID=sub-plan-{id}. (4) Clicking 'Choisir' on Starter redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_live_... showing 'Subscribe to Casanéo Starter — jusqu'à 3 logements €39.00 per month' with merchant 'MHP IMMOBILIER' and Stripe payment methods (Card / Apple Pay / Amazon Pay / Klarna / Satispay). NO payment attempted, went back safely. (5) PAYWALL: mutated billing.trial_ends_at='2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' + billing.pending_session_id=null via pymongo, re-login → GET /api/billing/status returns 402 (verified via console) and the blue-night PaywallScreen renders correctly: lock icon, 'Votre essai gratuit est terminé', sub-text, 3 buttons ('Voir les formules', 'J'ai souscrit — actualiser', 'Se déconnecter') with testIDs paywall-subscribe/paywall-refresh/paywall-logout. Clicking 'Voir les formules' opens /settings/subscription which now shows '⏳ Essai terminé' status card in error red with plans still selectable. (6) 'Se déconnecter' returns to /login. (7) REGRESSION: qa.admin@casaneo.test / CasaneoQA2026! (historical exempt account) logs in with FULL access — dashboard shows 61% occupation, 65374 €, 23 logements, 53 à venir (NO paywall); navigated to /calendar → Réservations list loads normally with tabs Toutes/Demande/Confirmée/Arrivées and reservation cards. (8) CLEANUP done: db.users.deleteOne({email:qa.signup.1788178233@example.com}) removed 1 doc, db.user_sessions.deleteMany removed 1 session. SAFETY: no Stripe card entered, no payment attempted, no Channex message/review sent, no .env modified.

action_items: No blocking issues. Feature ready to ship. Optional: consider adding testID on the header hamburger/menu icon in _layout to make drawer-based navigation deterministic in Playwright (drawer-{key} testIDs already exist inside the drawer, but the toggle relies on generic Ionicon svg — not a bug, just a testability polish).
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx PaywallScreen (lines 148-167): styles are inline-fixed #020830 background + white text — good, does NOT depend on theme colors so it renders correctly whether or not applyThemePref has run. testIDs paywall-subscribe/paywall-refresh/paywall-logout wired correctly.

app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx DrawerLayout (lines 179-204): gate 'if (locked) return <PaywallScreen>' runs after user is loaded and before Drawer renders — correct order; 402 from GET /billing/status flips locked=true through both the .then(s => !s.entitled) branch AND the catch that matches 'essai gratuit est terminé' — belt-and-braces, safe.

app/settings/subscription.tsx (lines 74-100): status card correctly branches on status.status ('exempt' | 'trial' | 'active' | 'locked'); the {st !== 'exempt' && ...} guard hides plans for founder accounts — correct product behavior.

app/register.tsx: password validation is client-side (length>=8) — matches backend rule; blue-night theme is hard-coded (#020830) so signup screen looks identical in light/dark preview — good for the SaaS onboarding brand consistency.

Trial 'X jours restants' rendering (subscription.tsx line 83) uses status.trial_days_left from backend — displayed 13 when trial_ends_at was ~13.99 days in the future, i.e. floor(seconds/86400). Product-consistent. Confirmed on-screen '13 jours restants (jusqu'au 14/09/2026)'.
Note: current server time in preview environment is Aug 2026 (test env clock ahead of the Jan 2026 stated in the system prompt) — trial dates reflect server clock, not a bug.

context_for_next_testing_agent: SaaS onboarding + paywall + Stripe checkout is fully working end-to-end. Register testIDs: go-register (login), register-name/-email/-password/-submit (register). Subscription testIDs: sub-back, sub-plan-{starter|essentiel|pro|scale}, sub-portal (only for active). Paywall testIDs: paywall-subscribe / paywall-refresh / paywall-logout. To reproduce paywall in QA: signup a fresh account, then run in mongo `db.users.updateOne({email:'<x>'}, {$set:{'billing.trial_ends_at':'2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00','billing.pending_session_id':null}})` and reload. To reproduce exempt: use qa.admin@casaneo.test / CasaneoQA2026! — this member is attached to a historical owner whose users doc has no billing field (or billing.exempt=true). WARNING: Stripe key is LIVE (sk_live_...) — never fill card details on the checkout page during automated tests.
